  "reasons": [
    "According to NCERT Chapter 6 (Cash Flow Statement), the primary objective is to provide useful information about cash flows (inflows and outflows) under operating, investing, and financing activities.",
    "Option B directly states this objective, while A, C, and D mischaracterise the function of the cash flow statement."
  ],

    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "The cash flow statement is meant solely to compute and disclose accounting profit.",

      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "The statement's sole purpose is to report the closing cash and cash equivalents balance.",

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To show only the profit earned in the period",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The primary objective of cash flow statement is to provide useful information about cash flows (inflows and outflows) of an enterprise during a particular period under various heads",
      "reason": "It discloses cash flows under three activity heads, not period profit."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The primary objective of cash flow statement is to provide useful information about cash flows (inflows and outflows) of an enterprise during a particular period under various heads, i.e., operating activities, investing activities and financing activities.",
      "reason": "Accurately quotes the primary purpose stated in NCERT."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To replace the income statement and balance sheet",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The primary objective of cash flow statement is to provide useful information about cash flows (inflows and outflows) of an enterprise during a particular period under various heads",
      "reason": "The cash flow statement supplements rather than replaces the other statements."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "To report only cash held at year end",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The primary objective of cash flow statement is to provide useful information about cash flows (inflows and outflows) of an enterprise during a particular period under various heads",
      "reason": "It details inflows and outflows across activities, not merely closing cash."
    }
  ]
